History of Nemura: Nemura was born in a small town in Mexico. Her parents were farmers and she grew up surrounded by nature. She had a talent for music and spent many hours singing and playing guitar. When she was 16, she met a group of surfers who introduced her to the sport. She fell in love with the ocean and spent the next few years traveling to different beaches and learning to surf. During her travels, she met many interesting people and had many adventures. When she was 20, she decided to settle down in a small beach town in Mexico. She started picking and selling arándanos to make a living, and spent her free time singing and playing guitar. She also started to explore the nearby forests and mountains, and discovered a love for nature.
